name: 83467 · Salmon, ID
findings: ZIP 83467 (Salmon) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83467 (Salmon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
